  "correction_rules": [
    "Adjust forecasts downward when sentiment history shows negative bias (e.g., -0.25 or 0.00 with recent lows).",
    "Reduce forecast volatility after consecutive negative sentiment entries; model tends to overreact.",
    "If true outcome spikes above forecast, reduce subsequent forecast by 5-10% to avoid overshoot.",
    "When sentiment shifts from neutral to positive (e.g., 0.00 → 0.33 or 0.50), increase forecast slightly to capture upward momentum.",
    "Apply mean reversion: if forecast is consistently above true outcome for 3+ days, reduce by 2-5% per day.",
    "For horizon > 15 days, reduce forecast by 1-2% per day if sentiment remains flat or negative.",
    "If true outcome is consistently below forecast (e.g., 3+ days), consider downward bias correction by 3-5%.",
    "Avoid over-optimism in early forecast days (e.g., day 1-3) when sentiment is neutral; use 1-2% conservative buffer."
  ]
}
